title: OP-18 reaches Japan today (21 Nov, unconfirmed)
detail: English launched yesterday. A French retailer blog gives Japan as Saturday 21 Nov, but sources disagreed earlier this week (21, 22 or 28 Nov), so treat it as unconfirmed. No official French release date found yet; French pre-release events run from 21 Nov.

title: Latin America Internationals continues in São Paulo (Day 2 today)
detail: Event runs 20–22 Nov. I could not find confirmed Day 1 results or standings, so no winners to report. Champions League Chiba is tomorrow (22 Nov), Regional Stuttgart Sat 28 Nov.

title: Regional Oklahoma City is today
detail: Sat 21 Nov, USA. Bristol (UK) is listed by its organiser for 21–22 Nov; other regionals' dates still conflict (unconfirmed). Results not yet available.

title: Réunion: Miyata Delta Reign stock unchanged since yesterday
detail: Tripack €19.99, 6-booster bundle €44.99, display €239.99 and single booster €7.99 show as available; Elite Trainer Box (€79.99) sold out. Only the ETB is clearly labelled sold out, so confirm before travelling.

title: Price check: Mega Darkrai ex 116 is the only notable riser (+14%)
detail: TCGdex/Cardmarket: 7-day €203.92 vs 30-day €179.46 (+14%), trend €192.07. Below the 20% line. Mew ex 152 7-day €78.83 vs 30-day €84.22 (−6%); Gengar and Mewtwo ex also −4% to −7%.
